Mass Combat

For battles with many combatants, the War Machine converts each unit into a Combat Result using troop class, hit dice, morale and leaders. Opposing results are compared on the War Machine table to produce casualties, gains and losses. The Siege Machine resolves attacks on fortifications using class, armor and construction factors.

Leaders add their level and ability bonuses; terrain, surprise and morale can shift the result. The system resolves the battle as a whole rather than individual attacks.
